title.zh: AgentDock Bridge · 云端 AI 会话与本机环境的 MCP 桥接工具
title.en: AgentDock Bridge · Remote MCP Bridge with Local Windows Approval

summary.zh: 把云端 AI 会话连接到本机 Windows 开发目录的个人 MCP 桥接小工具，通过 Cloudflare Worker 做 OAuth 鉴权，并要求本机逐条审批后在 Linux 容器中执行命令。
summary.en: Personal MCP bridge connecting cloud AI sessions to local Windows folders via Cloudflare Worker OAuth, local per-request approval, and Linux Docker containers.

zh: 每次读写文件或执行命令都需要在 Windows 本机连接器上手动确认，单次有效
命令在非特权、只读根文件系统的 Linux Docker 容器内运行，不挂载宿主敏感目录与 Docker Socket
使用 Windows DPAPI 保存本机凭据，并检查路径中的符号链接与目录越界
en: Requires explicit local approval on Windows for each file or shell request
Runs commands inside non-privileged, read-only Linux Docker containers without mounting host sensitive paths
Stores local credentials with Windows DPAPI and checks for symlink or path traversal

milestone.zh: 已完成 Worker 鉴权、本机审批脚本与容器隔离执行流程。
milestone.en: Worker OAuth, local approval connector, and container execution are complete.
